title: Syllabus Overview
notes: Unit 2: Floral Diversity · A: Botany · 30 teaching hours

• Introduction: Three domains of life, binomial nomenclature, five kingdom system, status of flora in Nepal and global representation.
  • Fungi: Characteristic features of phycomycetes, ascomycetes, basidiomycetes, deuteromycetes; Mucor, Yeast, Mushrooms (poisonous/non-poisonous), economic importance.
  • Lichen: Features and economic importance.
  • Algae: Features of green, brown, red algae; Spirogyra structure and reproduction; economic importance.
  • Bryophyta: Features of liverworts, hornworts, moss; Marchantia morphology and reproduction; economic importance.
  • Pteridophyta: Features and Dryopteris morphology/reproduction; economic importance.
  • Gymnosperm: Features and Pinus morphology/reproduction; economic importance.
  • Angiosperm: Morphology (root, stem, leaves, inflorescences, flowers, fruit); Taxonomy (hierarchy, systems: artificial, natural, phylogenetic); Study of families: Brassicaceae, Fabaceae, Solanaceae, Liliaceae.
